name: Saugrausch: Planet Vacuum
summary: Forget dusting the living room. it's time to vacuum the entire Earth. In Saugrausch, you play as an unstoppable suction machine with an endless appetite. Start by inhaling stray socks and pebbles, level up your gear, and work your way up to trees, skyscrapers, and mountains. No speck of dust is safe. Can you suck the planet completely dry?
